log.msg: Dawn, day 1. Salt Flats. Hot days, thin water, dust on the wind.
Somewhere to the west there is a town. Find it: its people know what this land is waiting for.
Your camp has a well. A cloak, a lantern and fuel are stored here: open Pack to take them.
A year of long nights. Days run only from eight until six.
A long world, 6 regions by 2: a narrow land, short one way and long the other.
God mode: nothing can see you, hurt you or stop you.
You are in the Wandering Rock (drifting isle).
God mode is off. You are mortal again.
